help.title: Help & Contact
help.q1: How do I ask for help?
help.a1: Go to the home page and tap the "+" button at the bottom right. Fill in the form with the title, description and category of your request. You can also add photos and set a price. Once published, your request is visible to providers around you.
help.q2: How do I chat with a provider?
help.a2: When a provider is interested in your request, tap the "Chat" button on the request detail page. The built-in messenger lets you exchange in real time. After a few messages, the secure payment becomes available.
help.a3: The payment is held until the mission is complete. Once the service is done, you confirm completion and the funds are paid to the provider. If an issue arises, our mediation team can step in.
help.q4: How do I become a provider?
help.a4: You can apply to become a provider from your account settings. Fill in the form with your skills and experience. Our team will review your application within 48 hours. Once approved, you can offer your services to requesters.
help.a5: Yes, we offer identity verification via an official ID. Verified members get a blue badge. It is not mandatory but highly recommended for trust between members.
help.a6: In case of disagreement, first contact the other member via the messenger to find a solution. If no agreement is found, write to us at askoo.contact@gmail.com. We review each situation and make a decision within 48 hours.

privacy.title: Privacy & Legal
privacy.rgpdContent: Under the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), you have the right to access, rectify and delete your personal data. The information you share (name, email, location, bank details such as your IBAN when requesting withdrawals) is only used to run the platform: matching, messaging, payments and transfers. We never sell data to third parties. You can request the deletion of your account and all your data at any time from the settings.
privacy.cguContent: By using Askoo, you agree to comply with these terms. The platform acts as a matching intermediary between requesters and service providers. Each user is responsible for their listings and services. Disputes between members should first be resolved amicably. The Askoo team reserves the right to suspend any account that fails to comply with the rules.
privacy.cookiesContent: We use cookies essential to the platform's operation (authentication, user session). Anonymous analytics cookies help us improve the experience. You can configure your cookie preferences at any time through your browser settings. No advertising cookies are used on Askoo.
privacy.legalContent: Askoo is a matching platform between individuals for local services. Published by Askoo SAS, 82 Grande Rue, 92380 Garches. SIRET: 123 456 789 00012. Publication director: The Askoo team. Hosting: Supabase Inc., 111 Sutter Street, San Francisco, CA 94104.
